backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing user profiles, social media links, and portfolio items with access‑controlled CRUD operations and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Aggregates feature evidence linking features to frontend files, components, and test IDs for build verification.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of major frontend files, components, hooks, and pages for quick reference.
frontend/index.css: Defines global medieval‑fantasy themed design tokens, fonts, colors, and motion settings using Tailwind layers.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document with metadata, favicon, and root mount point loading the main React entry.

frontend/src/hooks/usePageMeta.ts: Updates document title and description meta tag for a page.

frontend/src/index.css: Imports the project's root CSS file.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
